text:
sam csm: Kicking off Caldera preview onboarding — they confirmed 8 seats for next Wed (week0). Need: sandbox ready, enablement session, intake for use-cases + sample prompts. Can we align owners?

tara se: I can stand up the sandbox namespace. Need the region (they asked for eu-west-1) and whether we should pre-load sample dataset.

sam csm: Yes region = eu-west-1. They asked to pre-load a small synthetic dataset (anonymized logs) — I'll share S3 link once we get their consent.

jordan cs-ops: Seat allocation done in seat-tracker, added Caldera -> preview cohort, 8 seats. Link: https://redwood.internal/seat-tracker/preview?org=caldera :thumbsup:

priya enablement: I can run a 45m shiproom + 15m followup on Tues 10am PT (convert to EU folks). Will need a 1-page prep doc from them: primary workflows + 5 sample prompts. Can we send a short intake?

sam csm: I'll send the intake form tonight. Quick copy for the form: 'Primary objective, top 3 success metrics, example prompts (max 10), data retention constraints, SSO contact'.

tara se: For infra checklist — plan: prefix caching enabled, batching target ~60ms tail, quant profile q4_0 for cheaper tokens in preview. Also need API key provisioning flow for their SREs.

mike product: Noted. We'll pin model variant v1.2-preview for the cohort and enable auto-fallback to v1.1 if latency > 500ms. Also will hook up regression alerts to the eval-suite we ran.

jordan cs-ops: Added a canary route in routing policy: route=eu-west-1, tier=preview, fallback=model:v1.1. I've created a quickplaybook in docs: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/caldera-preview.md

priya enablement: Prep materials: I'll reuse the 'preview-playbook' deck but need 2 screenshots showing console routes + how to read per-route cost breakdowns. @tara can you export those?

tara se: Yep, I'll grab screenshots and paste into the deck. Also creating a quick runbook for their SREs with the sample cURL to test:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY"\\ \n  -d '{"model":"v1.2-preview","input":"hello"}'\\ \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

sam csm: Heads up — Caldera flagged SSO and data isolation as potential renewal risks later. Sales asked we capture any compliance blockers early. I'm putting together a short risk note and will tag Enterprise Sales.

mike product: If they require stricter isolation we can propose Dedicated or Private options, but capture their constraints now so we don't get surprised.

deploy-bot: release-candidate deployed to preview-caldera namespace (rc-2026-03-20) — routing, metrics exporter, and KV cache enabled.

sam csm: Action items recap: 1) I send intake + collect sample prompts (today EOD). 2) @tara stand up sandbox + screenshots (tomorrow EOD). 3) @priya run enablement Tue 10am PT (invite sent once intake done). 4) @jordan finalize seat link + routing policy (done). 5) @mike monitor model canary and alert on regressions. I'll follow up with Sales about SSO risk. Anything else? :raised_hands:

priya enablement: nothing else from me, I'll prepare the follow-up checklist for success metrics capture.

tara se: all good — will ping when sandbox URL is up.

jordan cs-ops: noted, closing loop on seat invites once intake is in.

sam csm: great, thanks everyone. I'll post the intake form link in this thread once sent. :rocket:
